title: Partial SESSION_FEATURES update copies another client's setting
description:
`indigo_libs/indigo_session.c:51-67` stores feature values in one shared property. Enumeration writes both fields from the enumerating client, but a change copies only named request items into that shared property and then copies **both** resulting values into the requesting client. For example A has FORCE_ITEM_UPDATES=true; B enumerates with both flags false; A sends only FORCE_PROPERTY_UPDATES=true. A's unmentioned FORCE_ITEM_UPDATES is reset to B's false value. Partial named-item updates are the normal bus contract, and these flags explicitly belong to the requesting client. Remediation: seed the shared response values from the requesting  Full evidence: C-02. Remediation: seed the shared response values from the requesting client under appropriate ownership before applying a partial update, or derive each client field independently from present request items; publish only to that client. Unit regression interleaves two clients' enumeration and one-item updates. No cross-client runtime test was run here.
